articles.summary: 论文提出 HyVox，将神经形态计算与冯·诺依曼边缘计算结合，用于开放集说话人识别。其目标是在极低能量预算下维持语音智能任务，这关系到边缘设备上的持续语音感知。由于提供的文本仅包含开场与截断的方法描述，具体性能与系统细节尚不可见。

articles.sourceExcerpt: HyVox: Rethinking Low-Power Voice Intelligence with Hybrid Neuromorphic–von Neumann Edge Computing SNEHASIS ADDY,University of Massachusetts Amherst, USA EDUARDO CALLE ORTIZ,University of Massachusetts Amherst, USA PRASHANT SHENOY∗,University of Massachusetts Amherst, USA PHUC NGUYEN∗,University of Massachusetts Amherst, USA In this paper, we presentHyVox, a hybrid neuromorphic–von Neumann system for low-energy open-set speaker identification underextremely tight energy budgets.HyVoxsplits the workload at the speaker embedding. Aneuromorphic processorembeds the speech with sparse, event-driven computation, and avon Neumann microcontrollerholds the speaker gallery and makes every decision: it scores queries by cosine similarity, rejects unknown speakers, and enrolls new users by writing a prototype, with no weight update. On the neuromorphic processor, a hierarchical temporal abstraction (HTA) SNN backbone learns a synaptic time constant per leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) neuron, allocating832neurons across fast, medium, and slow timescales.

articles.title: qybaihe/bla
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + Community signal
articles.summary: 该 GitHub 项目提出 BLA（Blind LLM Agents），用“毒化→耗尽→幻觉”的对抗策略，防御 REA 等 AI 逆向工程智能体，覆盖二进制、Electron 应用、JS 包、Python 与 WebAssembly。仓库已有 2247 stars 和近期公开活动，说明该方向受到一定关注；它值得看的是把 AI 逆向工程视为现实攻击面，并尝试提供跨技术栈的防护思路。
articles.failureAnalysis: 这类防御可能陷入与 AI 逆向工程智能体的持续对抗，攻击方模型和工具更新后，防护规则容易失效，验证成本高。跨二进制、Electron、JS、Python 和 WebAssembly 做统一防护，工程复杂度和运行时开销都不低，还可能造成误伤或破坏正常构建。真实需求是否足够强、用户是否愿意为防护付费、开源项目如何分发和持续维护，也都尚未从提供信息中体现。若策略依赖“毒化→耗尽→幻觉”这类间接干扰，误报、合规与安全边界不清会限制落地。
articles.highlight: BLA 以“毒化→耗尽→幻觉”的对抗性防御盾，保护二进制、Electron 应用、JS 包、Python 与 WebAssembly 免受 REA 等 AI 逆向工程智能体攻击。

en.highlight: BLA is an adversarial defense shield that protects binaries, Electron apps, JS bundles, Python, and WebAssembly against AI reverse-engineering agents like REA.
en.summary: The GitHub repository presents BLA (Blind LLM Agents), which uses a 'Poison -> Exhaust -> Hallucinate' strategy to defend software artifacts against AI reverse-engineering agents. With 2,247 stars and recent public activity, it is worth reading as an early attempt to treat AI-driven reverse engineering as a real attack surface and to offer cross-stack protection.
en.failureAnalysis: The defense may be brittle in an arms race with rapidly evolving AI reverse-engineering agents, and supporting binaries, Electron, JS, Python, and WebAssembly adds engineering and runtime overhead. Demand, willingness to pay, distribution, and maintenance are not established by the available information.
en.title: BLA: A Blind LLM Agents Defense Shield Against AI Reverse Engineering
